---
title: "Bayesian model report"
subtitle: "Quarto + CmdStanR"

---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(posterior)
library(bayesplot)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidybayes)
library(gt)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(knitr)

# Helpful functions

sigfig <- function(vec, n=3){ 
  ### function to round values to N significant digits
  # input:   vec       vector of numeric
  #          n         integer is the required sigfig  
  # output:  outvec    vector of numeric rounded to N sigfig
  
  formatC(signif(vec,digits=n), digits=n,format="fg", flag="#") 
}

# Theme set

theme_set(theme_ggdist())
theme_update(text = element_text(size = 24),
             plot.subtitle=element_text(hjust=0.5))


# Reporting only: do not compile or sample here.
fit_prior <- readRDS(here("fits", "prior", "fit.rds"))
fit <- readRDS(here("fits", "posterior", "fit.rds"))
stan_data <- readRDS(here("data", "stan_data.rds"))
metadata <- readRDS(here("fits", "metadata.rds"))

draws <- as_draws_df(fit)
draws_plot <- draws %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 500)

draws_prior <- as_draws_df(fit_prior)
draws_prior_plot <- draws_prior %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 500)

# This report reads the latest saved prior and posterior fits. # It does not compile the Stan model or launch sampling. To generate fresh draws, run `fit_model.R` deliberately.


```

# Stan implementation	Stan code and explanation



```{r}
#| label: stan-source
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

# The following is the exact Stan source copied to `fits/model.stan` by the most recent successful fitting-script execution.

stan_source <- readLines(here("fits", "model.stan"), warn = FALSE)
cat(
  "```stan\n",
  paste(stan_source, collapse = "\n"),
  "\n```\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

# Prior 

## Prior predictive checks

```{r}
#| label: prior-predictive-plot
#| fig-cap: "Prior predictive replicated outcomes."

yrep_prior <- as_draws_matrix(fit_prior$draws("y_rep"))

bayesplot::ppc_dens_overlay(
  y = stan_data$y,
  yrep = yrep_prior[
    seq_len(min(50, nrow(yrep_prior))),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)
```

# Data

## Simulated data

```{r}
#| label: data-simulation

tibble(
  quantity = c("Observations", "Predictor range", "Outcome range"),
  value = c(
    stan_data$N,
    paste(range(stan_data$x), collapse = " to "),
    paste(range(stan_data$y), collapse = " to ")
  )
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Experimental data

```{r}
#| label: data-real

tibble(
  quantity = c("Observations", "Predictor range", "Outcome range"),
  value = c(
    stan_data$N,
    paste(range(stan_data$x), collapse = " to "),
    paste(range(stan_data$y), collapse = " to ")
  )
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

# Computational diagnostics	R-hat, ESS, divergences, BFMI

## Sampler diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: sampler-diagnostics

fit$diagnostic_summary()
```


# Posterior 

## Posterior predictive checks	Does the model reproduce relevant features?

```{r}
#| label: posterior-predictive-plot
#| fig-cap: "Posterior predictive replicated outcomes."

yrep_post <- as_draws_matrix(fit$draws("y_rep"))

bayesplot::ppc_dens_overlay(
  y = stan_data$y,
  yrep = yrep_post[
    seq_len(min(50, nrow(yrep_post))),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)
```

## Parameter summaries

```{r}
#| label: posterior-summary

fit$summary() |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

# Provenance

```{r}
#| label: provenance

provenance <- tibble(
  item = c(
    "Date", "Model SHA-256", "Data SHA-256",
    "Prior seed", "Posterior seed",
    "CmdStan", "CmdStanR", "R"
  ),
  value = c(
    as.character(metadata$date),
    metadata$model_sha256,
    metadata$data_sha256,
    metadata$seeds[["prior"]],
    metadata$seeds[["posterior"]],
    metadata$cmdstan_version,
    metadata$cmdstanr_version,
    metadata$R_version
  )
)

knitr::kable(provenance)
```
